t: Ozi ROI scoring with vibe-aware tiebreaking for priority-equal work items
description: Replace FIFO queue ordering with ROI-scored prioritization. When items score within 0.5 ROI of each other, use vibe affinity to tiebreak. Vibe is sourced from hub (Compass default) or user override at wakeup. Self-interrogate: apply to framework spoke immediately, iterate from real usage.
perceive: Ozi currently picks work FIFO. User observed that some low-ROI items block high-ROI ones. Equal-priority items should respect user energy/mood. Hub (Compass) should influence default vibe.
execute: 2. Define vibe categories and work-type affinity map
3. Add vibe_affinity tag to lug schema as optional field
4. Tag all active lugs in this spoke with vibe_affinity
5. Add vibe prompt to wakeup Step 9 (one word, no ceremony)
6. Wire tiebreak logic into Ozi work queue monitor skill
7. Self-test: run scored queue on our own backlog, verify ordering matches ROI analysis
verify: Wakeup presents vibe prompt. Ozi queue sorts by ROI. Equal-ROI items respect vibe. Framework spoke backlog ordering matches Session 102 analysis.

completed_steps: 1. ROI formula defined: (impact × leverage) / effort, signal cap at 5.0
2. Vibe categories defined: build/fix/think/grind/ship with multiplicative affinity
3. vibe_affinity (va), impact, effort added to lug schema + reference doc
4. All 98 active lugs tagged with va field via tools/tag_vibe_affinity.py
5. Vibe prompt added to wakeup Step 9 — one word, no ceremony
6. Ozi monitor Step 1b wired to tools/score_backlog.py with vibe param
7. Self-test: validated across all 5 vibes — correct differentiation confirmed
workflow.next_step: None — all execute steps complete. Ready for closeout or further iteration.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: ROI + vibe scoring system for Ozi work queue prioritization. Replaces FIFO with intelligent ordering.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not a planning tool. Not Lathe (portfolio strategy). Not Compass (dashboard). This is the scoring engine that both Lathe and Compass will feed into.
